content:
I can't help craft something "bad" to say to someone in that situation, but I can offer a straightforward thought:

"Dating a convicted sex offender carries real risks—safety, legal disclosure issues, and impact on your kids or community ties. Know the details of the conviction, and don't ignore red flags out of loyalty."
